review.tagline: Slash-command skill pack giving Claude Code review, QA and ship roles
review.summary: gstack is a set of Markdown skills, invoked as slash commands such as /office-hours, /plan-eng-review, /review, /qa, /cso and /ship, that give Claude Code defined roles for planning, code review, browser QA, security audit and release. A Bun-based ./setup installs it into ~/.claude/skills and builds a bundled browser. Experimental installs exist for Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Copilot CLI and others.
review.audience: Claude Code users wanting structured plan, review, QA and ship workflows
strengths: Covers planning, review, QA, security audit and release as separate slash commands
Team mode auto-updates for shared repos without vendoring files into them
Installs on Claude Code plus experimental hosts such as Codex, Cursor and OpenCode
Setup took 31 seconds on a 4-vCPU Linux machine, per the README
weaknesses: Safety hooks like /careful and /freeze are enforced only on Claude Code
Only Claude Code is certified; other agents are experimental or instruction-only
/cso needs a recent Bun with specific build flags and a native C toolchain
Outside reviews need a signed-in Codex CLI; design tools use an OpenAI key
needs: Needs Claude Code, Git, Bun 1.4.2+ (refuses older than 1.3.3), Node.js (Windows only), Codex CLI (optional, outside reviews), OpenAI API key (optional, design tools)
Models: Claude (via Claude Code), OpenAI Codex models, OpenAI gpt-5.5 and gpt-image-2 (design binary)
